M-OP-TEST.Purpose: The test operation: run a harness by name — one in isolation (xunit | pickle) or all of them composed (the gate). The harness axis is a closed name registry (selection by name per P-FLEXVERSE-TOOLING.PRIN-006); the positional subject after the harness name belongs to that harness.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Scripts/test: harness name (default xunit), harness-owned positional subjects, --profile/--with for the game legs (pickle, all) only; the flow is declared inline as a linear pipeline in the command file.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Domain mechanics — owned by M-DOTNET / M-GAME / M-RUNS.

Requirements.REQ-001: Harness selection is by name from the closed HARNESS registry (xunit | pickle | all); unknown names and non-harness positional subjects fail loudly at startup (M-FV-CORE exit-code vocabulary).
Requirements.REQ-002: Flags apply only where they are meaningful: --profile/--with exist for the game legs and do not exist for xunit (game not needed).
Requirements.REQ-003: The xunit harness verdict is the dotnet exit code itself (0 pass, 1 fail, 2 infrastructure); the game legs inherit the game gate contract S-VERIFICATION.REQ-001.
Requirements.REQ-004: test never skips harness execution via cache: only builds and staging resume by fingerprint.
Requirements.REQ-005: `all` is the gate: xunit first (cheap, no game); the pickle leg runs only on xunit green, and a feature SUBJECT narrows the pickle leg only.

M-OP-TEST.Codemap: * `main` -> `parse_args` -> `HARNESS{xunit | pickle | all}` -> `xunit_leg`/`pickle_leg` -> `Pipeline` * `xunit_leg` -> `Pipeline.run('build_product')` (fingerprint resume) -> `xunit_run(dotnet_filter, check=False)` => 0|1 * `pickle_leg` -> `game_pipeline(spec)` -> `run_container` -> `evidence` => `report_exit_code` 0|1|2 * `all` -> `xunit_leg`; on green -> `pickle_leg` (the S-VERIFICATION verdict plane) * `#!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script` : invocation
